note: Small private RV park and cafe on Hwy 70 at the Caribou Rd junction, in the Feather River Canyon near Belden. The sites sit beside the river. A Pacific Crest Trail hiker stop; Quincy is ~30 min away for fuel. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read: 18 full-hookup sites at $79 (35 A and under) / $89 (50 A), plus tax and fees, and $795 a month. Booked by email or phone; closed November-March. Google 4.6 from 85 reviews. Not a Good Sam Park and no gateway within 40 km (Lassen 54 km), so it's a DROP CANDIDATE on price. Riverfront left as stored.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (price): the cheapest RV night is '$79 per night 35amps and under' (plus tax and fees), with no lower season posted. That is US$29 over the $50 gate. Not a Good Sam Park (absent from the directory cache), no operator member discount posted, and no gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: nearest Lassen Volcanic NP at 54 km). Google gives 'Caribou Crossroads RV Park Café' 4.6 stars from 85 reviews, so reviews don't rescue a $29 overage.

LONG-STAY: '$795 per month (not including electricity)' is marketed beside the posted nightly rate, so test 2 passes. I didn't run the occupancy check because there is no online engine ('Online booking will be available soon'). Nothing I read suggests a resident park.

PHONE: 530-283-1384 -> 530-720-0277. The operator site and Google both give (530) 720-0277, and the old number appears nowhere on the operator's pages. WEBSITE https://www.cariboucrossroads.com/ confirmed (the operator's live Squarespace site).

WATERFRONT: stored 'riverfront' left as stored. The operator says 'All spots are a few feet away from the river'. In imagery the pads are on a wooded tongue with a channel ~30-40 m wide along its west/north side; Hwy 70 separates them from the main North Fork channel to the south. I didn't measure pad heights because the entry is a price drop candidate. If it's kept, the channel width at the sites needs a closer look (under ~30 m would make it creekside).
SEASON: closed November-March, per the home page hours.
Pin 40.01442,-121.22529 matches the Google place point and sits beside the pads: fine.
